values.description: Django dev server on a STORE host. Replace `noor` with a store that exists in your local Django (a `tenants.Domain` row such as `<sub>.localhost`). Cookies of `*.localhost` are per store host.

Leave empty when base_url is a store host. To call a store through a public host (e.g. base_url=http://localhost:8000), set it to the store domain (`noor.localhost`) — TenantHeaderOverrideMiddleware. A session already bound to another store is refused (403 «الجلسة الحالية موثَّقة على متجر مختلف — لا يمكن التحويل إلى متجر آخر بهذه الجلسة.»).
